title: A Primer of the Scattergun
summary: Teaches an untrained shooter to seat the stock and carry the scattergun safely and fire it at close targets.

title: The Fowler's Loading Drill
summary: Teaches the order of powder and wad and pellets and how to recharge the piece swiftly behind cover.

title: Handbook of the Short Barrel
summary: Teaches close quarter fighting with a short barrelled scattergun held at the hip along lanes and corners.

title: Buckshot and Bore: First Lessons
summary: Teaches bore care and flint upkeep and the heavy buckshot blast together with simple tricks for close quarters.

title: Workbook of the Shoulder Stock
summary: Teaches how cheek and shoulder carry the aim and how the stock itself serves as a striking club.

title: Treatise on Qi in the Charge
summary: Teaches a new Senior to pass a thread of qi into powder and pellets so the shot flies tighter.

title: Guide to the Spreading Shot
summary: Teaches a Senior to judge how wide the pellets will open and to widen or hold the spread with qi.

title: Drill-Book of the Hedge and Doorway
summary: Teaches a Senior to fire from thresholds and hedge gaps and to move between points of cover.

title: A Plain Course in Pellet Pattern
summary: Teaches a Senior to read the pattern a load leaves and to shape thin or heavy patterns by hand and qi.

title: Canon of the Quick Charge
summary: Teaches a Senior to recharge the piece by habit and qi spark so the second shot follows swiftly.
